@@U01432@@
I’ve always been treated with the greatest courtesy.

@@U01434@@
What I’m trying to say is: Have you never thought seriously—

@@U01436@@
It never pays to trifle with women.

@@U01438@@
Oh, why can’t you understand!

@@U01440@@
For that I’m terribly sorry! But I do understand— you are kindness itself.

@@U01441@@
(They walk on.)

@@U01443@@
Did you know me again, little angel, the moment I entered the garden?

@@U01445@@
Didn't you notice? I lowered my eyes.

@@U01447@@
And you forgive me the liberty I took, my impudence, that day you came from the cathedral?

@@U01449@@
I was confused— it came as a shock. No one had ever had anything bad to say about me. I began asking myself if I'd
translation:
@@U01432@@
我一直受到最礼貌的对待。

@@U01434@@
我想说的是：你有没有认真思考过——

@@U01436@@
戏弄女人是没有好处的。

@@U01438@@
呵呵，你怎么就看不懂呢！

@@U01440@@
为此我深表歉意！但我确实明白——你本身就是善良。

@@U01441@@
（他们继续走。）

@@U01443@@
当我进入花园的那一刻，小天使，你又认识我了吗？

@@U01445@@
你没注意到吗？我垂下眼帘。

@@U01447@@
你能原谅我那天你从大教堂出来时的放肆和无礼吗？

@@U01449@@
我很困惑——这让我很震惊。从来没有人说过我的坏话。我开始问自己是否
